name: Trees and Ensembles
description: Grow decision trees and combine them into forests and boosted models.

requires.why: Later levels compare trees with logistic regression and use ROC curves.
Chooses tree depth and leaf size by cross-validation to control overfitting.

lessonObjectives.l1-yes-no-questions: Grow a tree by choosing the best split at each step.
lessonObjectives.l2-good-split: Compute Gini impurity and entropy for a split.
lessonObjectives.l3-memorising: Control overfitting with depth, leaf size and pruning.
lessonObjectives.l4-predicting-numbers: Fit a regression tree and read its step-shaped predictions.
lessonObjectives.l5-bagging: Reduce variance by averaging trees fitted to bootstrap samples.
lessonObjectives.l6-random-forest: Decorrelate the trees by choosing features at random.
lessonObjectives.l7-out-of-bag: Estimate test error from the samples each tree left out.
lessonObjectives.l8-which-features: Compare impurity importance with permutation importance.
lessonObjectives.l9-fixing-mistakes: Fit trees to residuals one after another.
lessonObjectives.l10-small-steps: Tune the learning rate and the number of trees together.
lessonObjectives.l11-gradient-boosting: Train a gradient boosted model with early stopping.
lessonObjectives.l12-trees-on-returns: Compare linear and tree models on a tabular returns problem.
